groups.activity: Assassination, Captain Vor and Lieutenant Lech Kril
conditions: Each kill rolls one of six: Miter Blueprint, Barrel, Blade, Handle, Chassis or the Twin Gremlins Blueprint, so Miter parts are the usual dud.
Kril is invulnerable in phase 1. Shoot the coolant pack on his back until a pipe breaks, and hit him while he is frozen. Four pipes make him fully vulnerable. Kill Vor too.
Avoid Cold procs, which lengthen his invulnerable windows. Radiation procs turn him on allies.
bonuses: Every run also rolls Frost parts and Miter parts.

disclosures.title: popping the pipes
disclosures.body: Explosive or high-burst weapons break pipes without precise aim: Arca Plasmor, Ignis aimed at the floor under him, Valkyr slams. Squadmates who pull his aggro or melee him disrupt his phases, so solo is usually faster.
